description: End-to-end bidding runtime timing, queue pressure, inbound marketplace events, OpenSea calls, and process resources. If every panel is empty, enable the bidding metrics endpoint, restart the bidding bot, and confirm the Prometheus target is healthy.

panels.description: Current or most recent scan inventory and settled jobs. Settled includes failed jobs and waiters discarded on Stop; it does not mean successful bids. Counts reset at scan start.
panels.title: Current Scan Progress

panels.description: Ages keep increasing without new runtime events. Inactive scan age is omitted; absent success means no successful scan has been observed in this process.

targets.expr: clamp_min(time() - min by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_scan_started_at_seconds{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"} > 0), 0) and (max by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_scan_active{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}) > 0)

clamp_min(time() - min by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_scan_last_progress_at_seconds{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"} > 0), 0) and (max by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_scan_active{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}) > 0)
targets.legendFormat: {{worker}} / {{chain_id}} / active scan time without settled-job progress

panels.title: Current Scan and Last Success Age

panels.description: Unfinished operations by bounded stage. Stages can nest, so adding stage counts is not a count of distinct jobs.
panels.title: Active Work Stages

panels.description: Age of the oldest unfinished operation in each stage, including startup and durable-command work. Empty stages are omitted, not reported as an epoch-sized age.
panels.title: Oldest Unfinished Work

panels.description: Calls currently inside the API/SDK boundary. Local rate-limit waiting is separate; no placement or cancellation retry policy is changed.

targets.expr: sum by (worker, chain_id, lane, operation, priority) (artgod_trading_bidding_opensea_in_flight{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"})

panels.title: OpenSea Calls in Flight

panels.description: Oldest API/SDK call age, still visible before any duration observation completes. All completed calls clear their in-flight timestamp.

targets.expr: clamp_min(time() - min by (worker, chain_id, lane, operation, priority) (artgod_trading_bidding_opensea_oldest_started_at_seconds{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"} > 0), 0)

panels.title: Oldest OpenSea Call

panels.description: Latest completed owner read: 1 succeeded, 0 failed; absent means not yet observed. Health gauges retain the last good read after failure. This is independent of exporter availability and business progress.
panels.title: Latest Health Sample Succeeded

panels.description: Age of each owner's last successful sample. Sampling runs immediately and then at the configured health cadence without overlapping reads or database work in scrape handlers. Compare with configured health_poll_ms; a stale sample is not fresh runtime evidence.
panels.title: Last Successful Health Sample Age

panels.description: Only active work without boundary progress for more than 600 seconds is shown. Matching Prometheus warnings require another 2m. Inspect child operations and logs; long work is not necessarily deadlocked. No automatic recovery or external notification delivery is configured here.

targets.expr: (clamp_min(time() - min by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_scan_last_progress_at_seconds{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"} > 0), 0) and (max by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_scan_active{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}) > 0)) > 600

(clamp_min(time() - min by (worker, chain_id, stage) (artgod_trading_bidding_work_last_progress_at_seconds{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"} > 0), 0) and (sum by (worker, chain_id, stage) (artgod_trading_bidding_work_active{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}) > 0)) > 600

panels.title: Work With No Progress

panels.description: Last sampled durable rows by status, excluding completed history. Stale processing is the reclaimable subset under the existing claim-timeout policy, not another queue status. Check collector health before interpreting retained values.
panels.title: Durable Command Backlog

panels.description: Creation age of the oldest pending or retryable command, before it is claimed. Empty queues are omitted. A failed/stale health sample can retain an old queue timestamp.
panels.title: Oldest Pending Command Age

panels.description: Process-lifetime transitions observed after successful persistence: completed, retry scheduled, terminal failure, and stale-claim recovery. These are not unique-command totals or durable audit history across restarts.
panels.title: Durable Command Outcomes

panels.description: Watched collections with fresh, stale or missing complete market data, evaluated by the actual adaptive TTL policy. Backoff may overlap any freshness state. Partial/error fetches never reset complete-data age.
panels.title: Market Data Freshness

panels.description: Oldest successful complete refresh among watched collections. Missing collections have no timestamp and are counted separately, so an empty age graph does not prove health.
panels.title: Oldest Complete Market Data Age

panels.description: Display publication is independent of market-data freshness. Missing and lagging can overlap. Startup cannot attest to an older persisted bid book until this process publishes it; removed collections leave this scope.

targets.legendFormat: {{worker}} / {{chain_id}} / newer complete market data awaiting publication

panels.title: Bid-Book Publication Status

panels.description: A recently written bid book can contain older market data. Failed writes preserve the previous successful publication timestamps; successful fetches alone do not reset them.
panels.title: Oldest Bid-Book Publication Age

panels.description: Base and maximum adaptive freshness TTL. The runtime combines these with last fetch duration and the configured multiplier; these are bounds, not per-collection effective TTLs.
panels.title: Configured Market Data Freshness Bounds

panels.description: Dimensionless multiplier applied to the previous complete fetch duration by the market-data freshness policy.
panels.title: Configured Fetch Duration Multiplier

panels.description: Process-lifetime strategy intentions: place, renew, adjust, maintain winning/capped, reuse target, or zero-ceiling skip/cancel. Intent is recorded before effects and can be followed by a failed action. Dry-run intent is separate.

targets.expr: sum by (worker, chain_id, decision, target_type, dry_run) (artgod_trading_bidding_decisions_total{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"})

panels.title: Bidding Decision Intents

panels.description: Last-known bot-owned positions for currently scheduled jobs, including unobserved jobs. Positions can be restored from durable state or become stale; they are not independent proof of current marketplace leadership.
panels.title: Last-Known Job Positions

panels.description: Currently scheduled jobs with each last-known constraint. One job may have multiple constraints; their sum is not a distinct-job total.
panels.title: Last-Known Job Constraints

panels.description: Process-lifetime place/cancel action outcomes. Success with dry_run=false means the action path completed; dry_run=true is simulated, not a marketplace write. Failure can include local tracking failure after an external effect, so it does not prove no offer was placed or cancelled.

targets.expr: sum by (worker, chain_id, action, result, dry_run) (artgod_trading_bidding_market_actions_total{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"})

panels.title: Marketplace Action Outcomes

panels.description: Last stage-boundary progress and last successful completion. Values persist when the stage is idle; compare with active work before diagnosing a stall. Failure updates progress but not success.
panels.title: Work Stage Progress and Success Age

panels.description: A value of 1 identifies the current lifecycle state for each bidding bot and chain ID.
panels.title: Runtime State

panels.description: Elapsed milliseconds from entering startBiddingRuntime until ready, after secret intake, configuration, policy agreement and metrics initialization. This is runtime bootstrap time, not total process startup time.

targets.expr: sum by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_runtime_time_to_ready_ms_sum{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}) / clamp_min(sum by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_runtime_time_to_ready_ms_count{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}), 1)

panels.title: Time to Ready per Bot Start

panels.description: Current-process lifetime average milliseconds for each completed startup phase. Startup failures remain authoritative in structured logs because the metrics endpoint can close before Prometheus scrapes a failed phase.

targets.expr: sum by (worker, chain_id, phase, result) (artgod_trading_bidding_runtime_bootstrap_phase_duration_ms_sum{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}) / clamp_min(sum by (worker, chain_id, phase, result) (artgod_trading_bidding_runtime_bootstrap_phase_duration_ms_count{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}), 1)

panels.title: Measurements Beyond Histogram Range

panels.description: Concurrent and queued work across the bidding pipeline. Sustained growth indicates work is arriving faster than it completes.
panels.title: Active Pressure

panels.description: Cumulative failures and rejected offer syncs for the current bidding bot process across commands, scans, refreshes, inbound normalization and dispatch, OpenSea, snapshots, and bid-book updates.
